name: Tenshi Akuma Kouhosei
source:
A newly born supernatural (angel/devil) girl is raised in the care of Keith the Angel and Rivelle the Demon.
Each day one of them is able to teach a lesson in good or evil.
After 7 days the newborn will inherit the properties of one species or the other.
Will Keith persuade her to the army of heaven? Will Rivelle convince her to side with his world?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ082276.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一个刚出生的超自然（天使/魔鬼）女孩在天使基思和恶魔里维尔的照顾下长大。
他们中的每一天都能够教授善恶的教训。
7天后，新生儿将继承一种或另一种物种的特性。
基思会说服她加入天军吗？里维尔会说服她站在他的世界一边吗？

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ082276.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
